name: Packaged fire-tube steam boiler
description: Shop-assembled shell boiler in which hot combustion gases pass through tubes surrounded by the water, typically in two to four passes with a reverse-flue turnaround. The standard packaged steam source for small and medium industrial loads and the workhorse of on-site utilities where steam demand runs from tens of thousands of pounds per hour downward.

subtypes.name: Multi-pass dryback / waterback
subtypes.description: Number of flue-gas passes and turnaround construction (water-cooled or refractory) vary by model line

subtypes.name: Quick-start low-water-volume steam generators
